label: RappelConso automobile recalls dataset
note: First derivation of data/vehicles/fr-recalls.json: 1,663 automobile fiches (2018-01-19 → 2026-08-07), the full RappelConso V2 open-data export for sub-category "automobiles, motos, scooters" (DGCCRF, Licence Ouverte 2.0) as committed in the controle-technique repo on 2026-10-02; 568 fiches matched to 94 curated models by that site's reviewed alias table. Records reshaped, never edited.

label: MLIT recall filings and owner complaints dataset
note: First derivation of data/vehicles/jp-recalls.json from the shaken-data MLIT snapshot of 2026-08-30: 919 unique recall filings (1,377 model links, 1994-03-24 → 2026-07-30) and 19,659 owner complaints across 75 models. Filing PDF URL pattern https://renrakuda.mlit.go.jp/mt/recallpdf/<no>.pdf verified 200 on 2026-10-03. Snapshot is a month old at build; freshness says due until the monthly refresh runs.

label: EU Safety Gate vehicle alerts
note: Stub only — eu_safety_gate_recalls returns covered:false with the official Safety Gate URL; no data is claimed or served. RappelConso republishes the Safety Gate automobile alerts that concern France, so fr_recalls_* covers most EU-wide vehicle recalls meanwhile.
